na॰ cyu--gatO karaRe tnaR । 1 bale niGa॰ । karttari tnaR । 2 gantari 2 aRqaje--2 kzIRapuRyajane” si॰ kO॰ । iti vAcaspatye cakArAdiSabdArTanirUpaRam । 2897 pf॰ cayaSabdapariSizwama । BAvapra॰ ukte 8 dozavfdDyAdO “kAlasvaBAvo'yamAhArAdi vaSAt punaH । cayAdIn yAnti sadyo'pi dozAH kAle viSezataH । cayakopaSamAH pUrvvAhRe vasantasya liNgaM, maDyAhne grIzmasya, aparAhRe prAvfzaH, pradoze vArzikam SaradamardDarAtre pratyUzasi hemantamupalakzayet । evamahorAtramapi varzAmiva SItozRavarzAdozopacayaprakopopaSamAn jAnIyAditi । suSrutaH । cayakopaSasA dozA vihArAhArasevanEH । samAnEryyAntyakAle'pi viparIte viparyyayam । samAnEH tulyEH cayAdiyogyEriti yAvat । viparyyayaM kAle'pi vEparItyaM boDyam । cayalakzaRamAha suSrutaH । KasTAnasTasya dozasya vfdDiH syAcCAsa kozWatA । pItAvaBAsatA vahnimandatA cANgagOravam । AlasyaYcayahetO tu dvezaSca cayalakzaRam । saYcayopahftA dozA laBante nottarAM gatim । te tUttarAsu gatizu Bavanti balavattarAH” । 2972 pf॰ coragaReSaSabdapariSizwam । coragaReSamantrAdikamuktaM gaReSavimarziRyAm “cakzurdvayaM taTA karRadvayaM nAsApuwadvayam । muKaM nABiM liNgamUlaM gudasTAnaM taTEva ca । manodvAraM BruvormmaDye daSEva dvArasaMjYitAH । aNkuSaM praTamaM vIjaM hfdaye daSaDA japet । prajapAnte tato mAtaH! kavAwaM niHkzipettataH । karRayoSca taTA kUrccaM kAlIM nAsApuwe tataH । muKe strIM dviviDaM vIjaM nABO vARIM tato japet । hasO vIjaM liNgamUlevaM gude parikIrttitam । oMkAraYca BruvormaDye manaHsTAne taTEvaca । etadekAdaSaM vIjaM pratidvAre kapAwavat । coragaReSamantra japtvA karmamAtraM na kuryyAt । yadi kuryyAttadAdoza ukto varRavilAsatantre । “gaReSa uvAca । aDunAhaM pravakzyAmi coramantramataH SfRu । coramantraparijYAnaM vinA he vrAhmaReSvari! । purARaM prapaWedyastu sa eva mUrttimAn kaliH । parajanmani pApizWaH sa BaveccOrakukkuraH । SivapUjA vizRupUjA SaktipUjA taTEvaca । sarvazUjAsu yattejo harate gaRapaH svayam । paYcASadgaRadevAnAM jyotIMzi munipuNgavA! । pratidvArapaTe gatvA pratipadmezu jfmBate । haranti japatejAMsi pratipadmezu saMsTitAH । japapUjA su yattejastatra cOro gaRADipaH । tasmAccOrapraroDArTaM cOramantraM japeddaSa । tatastu pUjayedDImAna yasya yA izwadevatAH । tataH PalamavApnoti brahmAditridivOkasaH । cOramantraM mahAmantraM paYcASadgaRatozaRam । cOramantraM vinA madre! SAntisvastryayanaM kutaH । karRadvayaM taTA cakzurdvayaM nAsA muKaM tataH । nABisTAne liNgamUle gudasTAne taTEva ca । manodvAraM BruvormaDyaM daSEkaM dvAramIritam । pratidvAre nyasenmantraM cOrAKyaM brAhmaReSvari! । cOramantraYcAha Badre! pratidvAre kapAwavat । rahasyaM te pravakzyAmi paYcASadgaRatozaRam । aNkuSaM paYcamaM vIjaM praTame daSaDA japet । prajapya suBage! mAtaH । kapAwaM niHkzipettataH । anyaTA aNkuSErvIjEH kapAwaM Bedire gaRAH । candrikAntargatAnityaM SaNkaraM varasundaram । candrikAsu samAlInaH SiYjinI aRimA guRaH । candravindvAtmikA nityA gaReSaparipUjitA । hrIM hrIM vijadvayamiti vinyasennayanadvaye । karRayoSca taTA hrIM hrIM hu~ hu~ nAsAdvaye taTA । muKeH strIM dviviDaM vIjaM nABO klIM suBagaSvari! । hasO vIjaM liNgamUle gudevaM parikIrttitam । huNkAraYca BruvormaDye manasTAne taTEva ca । etadakAdaSadvAre cOramantrARi vinyaset । daSaDA cOramantraYca ekaDA vApi vIjakam । anenEva japenApi pratidvAre kapAwakam” । japakAlo'pi tatrEva । “SfRu cApi pravakzyAmi mantrasya japanirRayam । prAtaHkAle ca SayyAyAM muktasvApaH svadehake । pUrbavanmAtfkAnyAsaM vinyasenmAtfkAsTale । taTA ekAdaSadvAre cOramantrARi vinyaset । daSaDA cOramantraYca ekaDA vApi saMjapet । cOramantrajapAt tuzwirgaReSasya tadA Bavet । yamasya nADikAro'pi cOramantrajapAt priye! । sarvamantrajapAttejaH sarvasmAt samupasTitam । tattejo haraRe SaktirgaReSastra nacEva hi” coragaReSo'pyatra । ayaYcaSabda uktapfzWe cArakaSabdAt paraM boDyaH tatra ca kara Cidretyatra karaRacCidreti SudDam karaRaM ca netrAdi । CidraM dvArAnAvaraRam ।

pu॰ cyavanena prASyate pra + aSa॰ karmaRi GaY । cakradattokte OzaDaBede yaTA “vilvAgnimanTaSyonAkakASmaryyaH pAwalI balA । parRyaScatasraH pippalyaH SvadaMzwrA vfhatIdvayam । SfNgI tAmalakI drAkzA jIvantI puzkarA guru । aBayA sAmftA fdDirjIrvakarzaBakO SaWI । mustaM punarRavA medA sUkzmElotpalacandane । vidArI vfzamUlAni kAkolI kAkanAsikA । ezAM palonmitAn BAgAn SatAnyAmalakasya ca । paYca dadyAt tadEkaDyaM jaladroRe vipAcayet । jYAtvA gatarasAnyetAnyOzaDAnyaTa taM rasam । taccAmalakamudDftya nizkulaM tElasarpizoH । paladvAdaSake BfzwvA dattvA cArdDatulAM Bizak । matsyaRqikAyAH pUtAyA lehavat sADu sADayen । zawpalaM maDunaScAtra sidDaSIte pradApayet । catuzpalaM tu gAmBAryyAH pippalyA dvipalantaTA । palamekaM nidaDyAcca tvagelApatrakeSarAt । ityayaM cyavanaprASaH paramukto rasAyanaH । kAsaSvAsaharaScEva viSezeRopadiSyate । kzIRakzatAnAM vfdDAnAM bAlAnAYcANgavardDanam । svarakzayamurorogaM hfdrogaM vAtaSoRitam । pipAsAM mUtraSukrasTAn dozAMScEvApakarzati । asya mAtrAM prayuYjIta coparunDyAnna Bojanam । asya prayogAccyavanaH suvfdDo'BUt punaryuvA । meDAM smftiM kAntimanAmayatvaM vapuHprakarzaM balamindriyARAm । strIzu praharzaM paramagnivfdDiM varRaprasAdaM pavanAnulomyam । rasAyanasyAsya naraH prayogAllaBeta jIrRo'pi kuwIpraveSAt । jarAkftaM pUrbamapAsya rUpaM biBartti rUpaM navayOvanAnAm । sitA matsyaRqikA'lABe DAtryASca mfdu Barjanam । caturBAgajale prAyo dravyaM gatarasaM Bavet .”

m: 1. च्यु (and च्युस्), cl. 10. च्यावयति (च्योसय्˚) = √ सह् or हस्, Dhātup. xxxiii, 72.

2. च्यु cl. 1. च्यवते (ep. also ˚ति; Subj. 1. sg. च्यवम्, RV. i, 165, 10; 3. pl. च्यवन्त, 48, 2 fut. च्योष्यते, AitBr. ii, 22; aor. 2. pl. अच्योढ्वम् [Subj. च्य्˚, MahānārUp.] and Prec. च्योषीढ्वम्, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 78, Kāś.) to move to and fro, shake about, RV. i, 167, 8; to stir, move from one's place, go away, retire from (abl.), turn off; vi, 62, 7; x; BhP. ix, 14, 20; to deviate from (abl.), abandon (duty &c., abl.; exceptionally gen., MBh. xv, 463 [C] inf. च्यवितुम्), Mn. vii, 98; MBh. iii; to come forth from, come out of, drop from, trickle, stream forth from (abl.; cf. √ 2. च्युत्), 14598; R. ii, 39, 15; to fall down, fall, slide from (abl.), v, 13, 31; to fall from any divine existence (so as to be re-born as a man), Jain.; to die, Buddh.; ‘to fall from’, be deprived of, lose (with abl.), Mn. iii, 140; viii, 103; Bhaṭṭ. iii, 20 (aor. अच्योष्ट); to fall away, fade away, disappear, vanish, perish, Mn. xii, 96; MBh.; BhP. iii, 28, 18; to fail, MBh. v, 1089; to sink down, sink (lit. and fig.), MuṇḍUp. i, 2, 9; (in the series of re-births), Bhag. ix, 24; to decrease (with instr.), MBh. iii, 14141; to bring about, create, make, RV. i, 48, 2; iv, 30, 22 (pf. 2. sg. चिच्युषे cf. Pāṇ. vi, 1, 36); viii, 45, 25 (pf. चुच्युवे); to cause to go away, make forget, MahānārUp.; Caus. च्यावयति (once च्यव्˚, ŚāṅkhBr. xii, 5; Padap. always च्यव्˚, p. च्यावयत्, RV. iii, 30, 4; impf. अचुच्यवुर्, i, 166, 5 and 168, 4; pf. च्यावयाम् आस, MBh. iii, 15920) P. to cause to move, shake, agitate, RV. i; iii, 30, 4; AV. x, xii; Ā. to be moved or shaken, RV. vi, 31, 2; P. to loosen, i, 168, 6; to remove from a place, drive away from (abl.), TS. ii, 2, 7, 5; ŚBr. i, x; MBh.; R.; to cause (rain, वृष्टिम्) to fall, TS. iii, 3, 4, 1; TāṇḍyaBr. xiii, 5, 13; ŚāṅkhBr. xii, 5; to deprive any one (acc.) of (acc.), R. ii, 53, 7; Intens. (impf. 2. pl. अचुच्यवीतन) to shake, RV. i, 37, 12 : Caus. Desid. चिच्यावयिषति or चुच्य्˚, Pāṇ. vii, 4, 81.
a: च्यु — {vI.v} {c1c} A. (च्यवते, च्युत) 1 To fall or drop down, slip, sink (fig. also); Ś. 2. 8. --2 To come out of, flow or issue from, drop, trickle or stream forth from; स्वतश्चयुतं वह्निमिवाद्भिरंबुदः R. 3. 58; Bk. 9. 71. --3 To deviate or swerve from, fall off or away from, leave (duty &c.); (with abl.) अस्माद्धर्मान्न च्यवेत Ms. 7. 98, 12. 71-72. --4 To lose, be deprived of; अच्योष्ट सत्त्वान्नृपतिः Bk. 3. 20, 7. 92. --5 To vanish, disappear, perish, be at an end; R. 8. 66; Ms. 12. 96. --6 To decrease. --7 To bring about, make, form, create. --8 To cause to go away, cause to forget. --Caus. ( च्यावयति-ते) 1 To cause to move, excite, agitate. --2 (A.) To move oneself, be shaken or moved. --3 To remove, drive away, expel. --4 To deprive, take away; Pt. 1. 240. --5 To cause to fall. {vII.v} {c10c} P. (च्यावयति) 1 To suffer, bear. --2 To laugh.

m: 1. च्युत् mfn. ifc. ‘moving’, see तृषु-च्युत्
‘shaking, causing to fall, removing, destroying’, see अच्युत-, ध्रुव-, पर्वत-, बाहु-, मद-च्युत्.

2. च्युत् (= √ श्चुत्, श्च्युत्) cl. 1. च्योतति (aor. अच्युतत् and अच्योतीत्; अच्युतीत्, Vop. viii, 38) to flow, trickle, ooze, Bhaṭṭ. vi, 28; to fall down, 29; to cause to stream forth, Uttarar. iii, 35; Bhaṭṭ. xv, 114 : Caus. च्योतयति, to lixiviate, Car. vi, 24.
3. च्युत् mfn. ‘distilling’. See मद-, मधु-.
a: च्युत् — {c1c} P. (च्योतति) 1 To drop, flow, ooze, trickle, stream forth; इदं शोणितमभ्यग्रं संप्रहारेऽच्युतत्तयोः Bk. 6. 28. --2 To drop or fall down, slip; इदं कवचमच्योतीत् Bk. 6. 29. --3 To cause to drop or stream forth. --4 To wet thoroughly, moisten.

m: च्युताधिकार mfn. dismissed from an office, W.
च्युताचार mfn. deviated from duty, PadmaP. v, 20, 9.
च्युताक्षर mf(आ)n. where a syllable has been dropped, Sāh. x, 14/15.

s: tri, (cyUyate sma iti । cyu + karmmaRi ktaH । yadvA cyut + GaYarTe kaH .) kzaritam । yaTA, -- “pivantaM tvanmuKAmBojacyutaM harikaTAmftam ॥” iti SrIBAgavatam ॥ (sKalitam । yaTA, raGuH । 11 । 25 । “samBramo'BavadapoQakarmmaRAM ftvijAM cyutavikaNkatasrucAm ॥”)
v: cyuta
kzaraRe BvA॰ para॰ aka॰ sew । cyotAta irit acyuta acyotIt । cucyota । cyutaH । “idaM SoRita maByagraM saMprahAre'cyutattayoH” idaM kavacamacyotIt” iti ca BawwiH ।
cyuta
tri॰ cyu--kta cyuta--ka vA । 1 gate 2 kzarite ca । acyutaH । cyutopalaH ।
m: 1. च्युत mfn. moved, shaken, AV. ix, 2, 15
gone away from (abl.), R. ii, 52, 27 and 72, 5
(with abl. or ifc.) deviated from (lit. [Pañcat. v, 3, 10/11] and fig. [Mn. viii, 418; xii, 70 ff.; Hariv. 11105 and 11188])
(said of arrows) failing an aim (abl.), L.
flying away from (abl. or in comp.; said of missile weapons), MBh. xiii, 4610; Hariv. 8088; R. iii; BhP. iii, 18, 5
expelled from, deprived of (abl.), MBh. iii; Bhaṭṭ. vii, 92
destitute of, free of (in comp.), Pañcat. i, 10, 26; Kathās. lx, 178
abandoned by (in comp.), VarBṛS. li, 2
disappeared, vanished, Hariv. 11173; Ragh. iii, 45; viii, 65; Bhaṭṭ. iii
come forth from, dropped from, streaming forth from (lit. and fig., as speech from the mouth), Mn. vi, 132; MBh. xiii, 2183; R. i-iii; BhP.; Bhaṭṭ. ix, 71
fallen from, fallen, MBh. &c.
fallen from any divine existence for being re-born as a man, Buddh.; Jain.
(in astrol.) standing in the ἀποκλίματα Laghuj. x, 5
sunk (morally), Kum. v, 81
(in math.) divided, Bījag.
cf. अ-, हस्त-.
2. च्युत mfn. ifc. id. See घृत-, मधु-.
a: च्युत — p. p. [च्यु-क्त च्युत्-क वा] 1 Fallen down, slipped, fallen. --2 Removed, expelled. --3 Strayed, erred, deviated from. --4 Deprived. --5 Broken, disordered. --6 Dropped, oozed out. --7 Lost, gone, perished; R. 3. 45. --8 Moved, shaken. --Comp. --अधिकार a. dismissed from office. --आत्मन् a. of a depraved soul, evil-minded; Ku. 5. 81.

k.v: स्रस्तं ध्वस्तं भ्रष्टं स्कन्नं पन्नं च्युतं गलितम्. लब्धं प्राप्तं विन्नं भावितमासादितं च भूतं च॥

m: च्युत—दत्ताक्षर mf(आ)n. where a syllable has been dropped or added, Sāh. x, 14.
च्युतक See अक्षर-मात्र-.
च्युत—पथक m. ‘deviated from the path’, N. of a pupil of Śākyamuni, Buddh.; L.
च्युत—संस्कार mfn. offending against grammar, Pratāpar.
च्युत—संस्कृति mfn. id., ib.; Kpr. vii, 2.

s: strI, (cyavate SoRitAdikamasyA iti । cyu + apAdAne ktin .) Bagam । iti hemacandraH । 3 । 609 ॥ gudadvAram । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ (cyu + BAve ktin .) kzaraRam । yaTA, -- “kuryyAM harasyApi pinAkapARerDEryyacyutiM ke mama Danvino'nye ॥” iti kumArasamBave । 3 । 10 ॥
v: cyuti

strI cyu--BAve ktin । 1 gatO “satyAt cyu--tiH kzatriyasya na Darmezu praSasyate” BA॰ A॰ 103 a॰ । “kuryyAM harasyApi pinAkapARerDEryyacyutiM ke mama Danvino'nye” kumA॰ । cyu BAve ktin । 3 kzaraRe । madacyutiH । cyotati SoRitamasmAt apAdAne ki । 4 gudadvAre SabdArTaci॰ ।
m: च्युति f. ‘banishment’, see देश-, ‘coming forth’, see गर्भ-, ‘oozing’, see जघन-
falling, falling down, gliding, Gaut.; Suśr.
(with गर्भस्य, ‘abortion’), VarBṛ. iv, 9, Sch.
fall, degeneration, Bhartṛ. iii, 32
fall from any divine existence (so as to be re-born as a man), Lalit. iv, 4 and 31; HPariś.
deviation from (abl.), MBh. i, 4169; Bhartṛ.
vanishment, loss (ifc.), Suśr.; Kum. iii, 10; Śāntiś.; BhP. x, 22, 20
perishing, dying, W.
the vulva, L.
(= चुति) the anus, L.
cf. स-, हस्ल-.
a: च्युतिः — f. [च्यु-भावे क्तिन्] 1 Falling down, a fall. --2 Deviation from. --3 Dropping, oozing. --4 Losing, deprivation; धैर्यच्युतिं कुर्यां Ku. 3. 10. --5 Vanishing, perishing. --6 The vulva. --7 The anus. --8 Quick motion.

m: च्युतोत्साह mfn. having spent one's energies, exhausted.
